description: Central America Road Ratio by ACH-GIS4Tech is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Acción Contra el hambre - GIS4tech. Sum of the lengths of all roads in the locality divided by the km2 of territory of each municipality, in order to know the road connectivity and local economic development. Data obtained from HumData and transformed by GIS4Tech. Categorized by country, department and municipality. For more information contact GIS4Tech: info@gis4tech.com. Coverage: El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua. The portal files it under the publisher Acción Contra el hambre - GIS4tech. Its tags are development, roads, socioeconomics. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-04-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution International (CC BY). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
